title: NeoPred dual-phase CT model predicts chemo-immunotherapy response in NSCLC
summary: Three 3D convolutional networks were developed on 509 retrospective NSCLC cases from four centers; the dual-phase model (NeoPred) reached AUC 0.772 in an external validation set (n=59) and 0.760 in a prospectively enrolled cohort of 50 patients, above the mean of nine radiologists (0.720). Model assistance improved reader performance. AUCs are modest and validation sets small.
ai_technology: Three 3D convolutional neural networks on pre-treatment, pre-surgical and dual-phase CT (NeoPred)
organization: First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University

evidence.tested: External validation set (n=59) and a prospective cohort (n=50), compared with nine radiologists.
evidence.unknown: Larger multinational validation, as the authors state, and effect on surgical decisions are not established; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Convolutional networks predicted pathologic response from CT images.

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
